chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 554: Wind Xi's Deadly Gamble with the Wind-Lightning Wings
chapter_meta_description: Wind Xi unveils his secret plan to forge Wind-Lightning Wings from a Thunder Roc fossil. But Han Li's celebratory drink was laced with a death sentence.
og_title: RMJI Ch 554: Forging the Wind-Lightning Wings
og_description: Wind Xi reveals a legendary artifact plan, but Han Li discovers the wine was a trap.
twitter_description: Han Li's toast comes with a lethal side effect as the demon Wind Xi plots to steal the power of lightning.

lore_anchors.definition: A high-grade demonic cultivator of the Flood Dragon clan, known for his brash, violent temperament and mastery of water-attributed techniques.
A demonic cultivator with a Profound Tortoise body, characterized by caution and a preference for defensive cultivation of its own shell.
A unique hybrid treasure being planned by Wind Xi, combining the wind speed of his Gale Clan heritage with the lightning power of a Thunder Roc’s bone wings.
A legendary celestial spirit bird whose flying speed is unmatched; its remains can retain innate lightning power for millennia, making them a supreme material for lightning-attributed artifacts.
A potent spirit brewed for demonic cultivators; for humans, it is poisoned with a latent Chaotic Evil Qi that is nearly impossible to purge and lethal within a year.

An insidious, primordial energy foreign to ordinary human bodies; when infused by a demon cultivator’s own essence, it becomes a curse that can only be countered by its creator, acting as a perfect hostage mechanism.
A major sea region of the demonic realm, a vast body of water that serves as a political and battleground zone for various aquatic demon clans.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is everyone in this chapter a demon?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The story has moved to the overseas demon sea regions. Wind Xi is a powerful Gale Beast demon, and his friends are also high-grade demonic cultivators, making this a largely demon-politics chapter.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li's expression change at the end?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Flood Dragon casually describes how his clan slaughtered two Nascent Soul cultivators. This is a nonchalant reminder of the vast power gap between him (a Core Formation human) and the beings he is currently trapped with.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the Chaotic Evil Qi a real thing?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In the context of this story, yes. It’s a specific curse-based poison native to the Green Flame Wine. It isn’t “fatal poison” in the normal sense; it’s a time-lock key that binds Han Li to Wind Xi’s success.
